verdict.rationale: Superhuman's docs say you can switch between Outlook and Gmail accounts inside one app, and that Gmail and Outlook calendars combine into one consolidated view. However, it is positioned only for Gmail and Outlook, with no evidence of IMAP or other providers, and email accounts are switched between rather than shown as a unified inbox. missing for 10: IMAP/generic provider support, evidence of a unified multi-account inbox (beyond switching), independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-account use

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: you can instantly switch between Outlook and Gmail accounts without switching apps.
Built for teams that use Gmail or Outlook
You can add all your Gmail and Outlook account calendars, and easily toggle them on and off. One single, consolidated view when you need it
